claims.claim: Isla Capitán Aracena is recognized by SBAP/SIMBIO as a geoform of the marine ecosystem Cockburn Magdalena - Magallanes (ECOMAR-056).
Isla Capitán Aracena is also recognized as a geoform of Estrecho de Magallanes Central - Magallanes (ECOMAR-058).
The basin Islas al Sur Estrecho de Magallanes includes a subbasin named Isla Capitan Aracena y adyacentes.
